description: A team dedicated to creating SEO-optimized blog posts, social media copies, and email campaigns.

team_roles.goal: Outline a content strategy, including target audience, key messaging, and SEO keywords.
Draft a long-form blog post following the content strategy and SEO guidelines.
Write engaging social media posts (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram) promoting the blog post.
Review all copies for brand consistency, readability, and SEO optimization. Reject if off-tone.
